subject: Exercise library: real dedupe/repoint data migration
description: CLOSED 2026-06-04 as obsolete, not built: the SharedExerciseLibrary migration added a case-insensitive unique index on ExerciseDefinition.Name, and every DB in existence was wiped/created at or after that migration — same-named duplicates cannot exist in any current DB, so the dedupe/repoint data migration has no data it could ever run against. Future schema changes are handled by normal EF migrations (proven on-device by MedicationForm); human-level near-dupes are handled by the /exercises merge tool. Original scope: dedupe same-named ExerciseDefinitions and repoint RoutineExercise/ExerciseSet/ExerciseFeedback FKs.
